SEO.title: Info · Zomaar Zomert
SEO.description: Practical info on Zomaar Zomert: location, parking, accessibility, activities, paella and pétanque. Everything you need to know before the last weekend of July.

openGraph.title: Info · Zomaar Zomert
openGraph.description: Location, parking, accessibility and activities. Everything you need to know before you head to the field.

activities.title: Join in.
activities.intro: There's more than music around Zomaar Zomert. Two big ones: the Zomaar Bike on Friday and the Zomaar Run on Sunday. Plus paella, pétanque and a quiz.

bike.title: Zomaar Bike
bike.body: Mountain bike and gravel through the green western edge of Brussels. Waymarked route with food stops along the way.

run.title: Zomaar Run
run.body: Running race over the Keperenberg. 7 or 14 km with official chip timing.

paella.title: Paella
paella.body: Long tables, one big pan and the neighbours as company. Sign-up required.

petanque.title: Pétanque
petanque.body: The yearly tournament on the field next to the tent. Sign-up required.

quiz.title: Quiz
quiz.body: The Zomaar Quiz in the run-up to the festival. Put together a team and come rack your brains.
